description: This file defines a Spring Data MongoDB repository interface for managing DocumentVersion entities, including methods for CRUD operations and custom queries like finding by document ID, version number, and status.

classes.name: DocumentVersionRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data MongoDB repository interface for DocumentVersion entities providing methods for CRUD and custom queries.

methods.name: findByDocumentId
methods.description: Retrieves all DocumentVersion instances associated with a specific document ID.

methods.name: findByDocumentIdAndVersionNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a specific DocumentVersion by document ID and version number, returning an Optional.

methods.name: findByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a list of DocumentVersion instances filtered by their status (e.g., PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED).
